scope: Local source preparation only, without providers or WebView
baseline: Equivalent pre-cache read, decode, validation, text assembly and character count; reconstructed in the diagnostic, not a checkout of an older release
method: Five rounds of 20 operations per mode, rotating mode order. Median of per-round average operation times. Filesystem page cache warmed before each sample. No timing thresholds.
coldMeaning: Application source-cache entry removed before each measured call; eviction time excluded. Filesystem cache remains warm.
limitations: No model latency, token usage, tool pagination, UI rendering or end-to-end generation measured
Registry initially small; not a large-vault contention benchmark
